name: Sergey Pronin
description: Sergey is a product leader focusing on delivering robust open-source solutions. After having consistently contributed to the growth of Percona and its product open source culture as a VP of Product, he is now leading the OpenEverest open source database and storage platform. Digital nomad, who enjoys spreading the word about data on Kubernetes. He loves playing tennis and hockey, but his major passions are his family, three kids and a dog.
